Replica en **Larch** la ruta conjunta MNL del notebook operativo
[`03_models/14_territorial_stepwise_mnl_nested.qmd`](/Users/vicenteonetto/Desktop/FCFM/MDS/Tesis_Local/tesis-project/03_models/14_territorial_stepwise_mnl_nested.qmd).

Alcance:

- solo `MNL`;
- misma muestra conjunta `Censo + OSM`;
- subconjunto final de la ruta A de modelos conjuntos;
- coeficientes territoriales para `BIP`, `QR_RED` y `QR_OTHER`;
- pensado como auditoría de robustez/memoria, no como reemplazo automático de Biogeme.

## 1) Setup

```{python}
#| label: setup
print("label: setup")

import gc
import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path

os.environ.setdefault("MPLCONFIGDIR", "/tmp/mplconfig")
os.environ.setdefault("XDG_CACHE_HOME", "/tmp/xdg-cache")

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import polars as pl
from scipy.stats import norm

if os.environ.get("LARCH_DISABLE_NUMBA_CACHE", "1") == "1":
    import numba as nb

    _original_njit = nb.njit
    _original_guvectorize = nb.guvectorize

    def _njit_without_cache(*args, **kwargs):
        kwargs["cache"] = False
        return _original_njit(*args, **kwargs)

    def _guvectorize_without_cache(*args, **kwargs):
        kwargs["cache"] = False
        return _original_guvectorize(*args, **kwargs)

    nb.njit = _njit_without_cache
    nb.guvectorize = _guvectorize_without_cache

import larch as lx
if not all(hasattr(lx, attr) for attr in ["P", "X", "Model", "Dataset"]):
    raise ImportError(
        "Este kernel no tiene una instalación completa de Larch. "
        f"Se importó {lx!r}, pero no expone P, X, Model ni Dataset. "
        "Selecciona un kernel/entorno con Larch instalado o instala Larch en este entorno "
        "antes de ejecutar este notebook."
    )

from larch import P, X


def resolve_project_root(start: Path | None = None) -> Path:
    current = (start or Path.cwd()).resolve()
    for candidate in [current, *current.parents]:
        if (candidate / "config").exists() and (candidate / "lib").exists():
            return candidate
    raise RuntimeError("No se pudo resolver PROJECT_ROOT desde el notebook actual.")


PROJECT_ROOT = resolve_project_root()
if str(PROJECT_ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(PROJECT_ROOT))

from lib.od_buffers_nested_logit import read_parquet_portable

print("PROJECT_ROOT:", PROJECT_ROOT)
print("Larch:", lx)
```

## 3) Helpers

```{python}
#| label: helpers
print("label: helpers")

def result_paths(model_name: str) -> tuple[Path, Path]:
    out_dir = RESULTS_DIR / model_name
    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    return out_dir / f"params_{model_name}.csv", out_dir / f"stats_{model_name}.csv"


def load_larch_numeric_df_from_parquet(path: Path, extra_cols: list[str]) -> pd.DataFrame:
    selected = BASE_COLUMNS + list(extra_cols)
    missing = [c for c in selected if c not in pl.scan_parquet(str(path)).collect_schema().names()]
    if missing:
        raise ValueError(f"Faltan columnas en {path.name}: {missing}")
    return (
        read_parquet_portable(str(path))
        .select([pl.col(c).cast(pl.Float64) for c in selected])
        .collect()
        .to_pandas()
    )


def prepare_larch_dataframe(pandas_df: pd.DataFrame, extra_cols: list[str]) -> pd.DataFrame:
    remap = {0: 1, 1: 2, 2: 3}
    cols = BASE_COLUMNS + list(extra_cols)
    pdf = pandas_df[cols].copy()
    pdf["choice_larch"] = pdf["choice_nested"].replace(remap).astype("int32")
    pdf = pdf.drop(columns=["choice_nested"])
    for col in pdf.columns:
        if col == "choice_larch":
            pdf[col] = pdf[col].astype("int32")
        else:
            pdf[col] = pdf[col].astype("float64")
    return pdf


def build_larch_stats_frame(model: lx.Model, n_obs: int) -> pd.DataFrame:
    stats_raw = model.estimation_statistics_raw(compute_loglike_null=True)
    stats = {
        "Number of estimated parameters": len(model.pf),
        "Number of free parameters": int((model.pf["holdfast"] == 0).sum()),
        "Sample size": int(n_obs),
    }
    for key, value in stats_raw.items():
        label = " | ".join(str(k) for k in key) if isinstance(key, tuple) else str(key)
        stats[label] = value
    return pd.DataFrame([stats])


def build_larch_params_frame(model: lx.Model) -> pd.DataFrame:
    pf = model.pf.copy().reset_index().rename(columns={"param_name": "Name", "value": "Value"})
    std_err = np.asarray(model.parameters["std_err"].values, dtype=float)
    classic_t = np.where(
        np.isfinite(std_err) & (std_err > 0),
        pf["Value"].to_numpy(dtype=float) / std_err,
        np.nan,
    )
    classic_p = np.where(np.isfinite(classic_t), 2 * norm.sf(np.abs(classic_t)), np.nan)
    robust_std_err = np.asarray(model.parameters["robust_std_err"].values, dtype=float)
    robust_t = np.where(
        np.isfinite(robust_std_err) & (robust_std_err > 0),
        pf["Value"].to_numpy(dtype=float) / robust_std_err,
        np.nan,
    )
    robust_p = np.where(np.isfinite(robust_t), 2 * norm.sf(np.abs(robust_t)), np.nan)
    pf["Std err."] = std_err
    pf["t-stat."] = classic_t
    pf["p-value"] = classic_p
    pf["Robust std err."] = robust_std_err
    pf["Robust t-stat."] = robust_t
    pf["Robust p-value"] = robust_p
    return pf[
        [
            "Name",
            "Value",
            "Std err.",
            "t-stat.",
            "p-value",
            "Robust std err.",
            "Robust t-stat.",
            "Robust p-value",
        ]
    ]


def beta(name: str):
    return getattr(P, name)


def x(name: str):
    return getattr(X, name)


def build_larch_joint_model(
    pandas_df: pd.DataFrame,
    *,
    model_name: str,
    extra_cols: list[str],
) -> lx.Model:
    pdf = prepare_larch_dataframe(pandas_df, extra_cols=extra_cols)
    ds = lx.Dataset.construct.from_idco(pdf, alts={1: "BIP", 2: "QR_RED", 3: "QR_OTHER"})
    m = lx.Model(ds)
    m.title = model_name
    m.compute_engine = "numba"
    m.choice_co_code = "choice_larch"
    m.availability_co_vars = {1: 1, 2: 1, 3: 1}

    part = MODEL_PARTITION
    v_bip = (
        beta(f"B_BIP_T_VEH_{part}") * X.TVH_BIP
        + beta(f"B_BIP_T_ESPERA_INI_{part}") * X.TEI_BIP
        + beta(f"B_BIP_T_ESPERA_TRASB_{part}") * X.TET_BIP
        + beta(f"B_BIP_N_TRASB_{part}") * X.NTR_BIP
    )

    v_red = (
        beta(f"ASC_QR_RED_{part}")
        + beta(f"B_QR_RED_LAB_PM_{part}") * X.DUMMY_LAB_PM
        + beta(f"B_QR_RED_LAB_PT_{part}") * X.DUMMY_LAB_PT
        + beta(f"B_QR_RED_NO_LAB_{part}") * X.DUMMY_NO_LAB
        + beta(f"B_QR_RED_ANIO_2025_{part}") * X.DUMMY_ANIO_2025
        + beta(f"B_QR_RED_LOG_DEMAND_{part}") * X.LOG_N_VIAJES_ZONA_INICIO_FRANJA
        + beta(f"B_QR_RED_LOG_BUS_STOP_DENSITY_{part}") * X.LOG_BUS_STOP_DENSITY
        + beta(f"B_QR_RED_LOG_BUS_LINE_COUNT_{part}") * X.LOG_BUS_LINE_COUNT
        + beta(f"B_QR_RED_LOG_METRO_LINE_COUNT_{part}") * X.LOG_METRO_LINE_COUNT
        + beta(f"B_QR_RED_T_VEH_{part}") * X.TVH_QR_RED
        + beta(f"B_QR_RED_T_ESPERA_INI_{part}") * X.TEI_QR_RED
        + beta(f"B_QR_RED_T_ESPERA_TRASB_{part}") * X.TET_QR_RED
        + beta(f"B_QR_RED_N_TRASB_{part}") * X.NTR_QR_RED
    )

    v_other = (
        beta(f"ASC_QR_OTHER_{part}")
        + beta(f"B_QR_OTHER_LAB_PM_{part}") * X.DUMMY_LAB_PM
        + beta(f"B_QR_OTHER_LAB_PT_{part}") * X.DUMMY_LAB_PT
        + beta(f"B_QR_OTHER_NO_LAB_{part}") * X.DUMMY_NO_LAB
        + beta(f"B_QR_OTHER_ANIO_2025_{part}") * X.DUMMY_ANIO_2025
        + beta(f"B_QR_OTHER_LOG_DEMAND_{part}") * X.LOG_N_VIAJES_ZONA_INICIO_FRANJA
        + beta(f"B_QR_OTHER_LOG_BUS_STOP_DENSITY_{part}") * X.LOG_BUS_STOP_DENSITY
        + beta(f"B_QR_OTHER_LOG_BUS_LINE_COUNT_{part}") * X.LOG_BUS_LINE_COUNT
        + beta(f"B_QR_OTHER_LOG_METRO_LINE_COUNT_{part}") * X.LOG_METRO_LINE_COUNT
        + beta(f"B_QR_OTHER_T_VEH_{part}") * X.TVH_QR_OTHER
        + beta(f"B_QR_OTHER_T_ESPERA_INI_{part}") * X.TEI_QR_OTHER
        + beta(f"B_QR_OTHER_T_ESPERA_TRASB_{part}") * X.TET_QR_OTHER
        + beta(f"B_QR_OTHER_N_TRASB_{part}") * X.NTR_QR_OTHER
    )

    for col in extra_cols:
        tag = PARAM_TAGS[col]
        v_bip = v_bip + beta(f"B_BIP_{tag}_{part}") * x(col)
        v_red = v_red + beta(f"B_QR_RED_{tag}_{part}") * x(col)
        v_other = v_other + beta(f"B_QR_OTHER_{tag}_{part}") * x(col)

    m.utility_co[1] = v_bip
    m.utility_co[2] = v_red
    m.utility_co[3] = v_other
    m.initialize_graph(alternative_codes=[1, 2, 3], alternative_names=["BIP", "QR_RED", "QR_OTHER"])
    m.set_cap(LARCH_MAX_CAP)
    return m


def estimate_larch_joint_model(spec: dict) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:
    df_model = load_larch_numeric_df_from_parquet(spec["sample_path"], spec["extra_cols"])
    model = build_larch_joint_model(
        df_model,
        model_name=spec["model"],
        extra_cols=spec["extra_cols"],
    )
    model.maximize_loglike(method=LARCH_METHOD, quiet=False, options=LARCH_OPTIONS)
    model.calculate_parameter_covariance(robust=True)
    stats = build_larch_stats_frame(model, n_obs=len(df_model))
    params = build_larch_params_frame(model)
    del df_model, model
    gc.collect()
    return stats, params
```

## 5) Ejecutar modelos

```{python}
#| label: run-larch-joint-route-a
print("label: run-larch-joint-route-a")

summary_rows = []

for spec in MODEL_SPECS:
    params_path, stats_path = result_paths(spec["model"])
    print(f"Estimando Larch: {spec['model']}")
    try:
        stats_df, params_df = estimate_larch_joint_model(spec)
        stats_df.to_csv(stats_path, index=False)
        params_df.to_csv(params_path, index=False)
        row = stats_df.iloc[0].to_dict()
        summary_rows.append(
            {
                "model": spec["model"],
                "sample_path": spec["sample_path"].name,
                "n_extra_vars": len(spec["extra_cols"]),
                "status": "ok",
                "error_type": None,
                "error_message": None,
                **row,
            }
        )
    except Exception as exc:
        print(f"ERROR en {spec['model']}: {type(exc).__name__}: {exc}")
        summary_rows.append(
            {
                "model": spec["model"],
                "sample_path": spec["sample_path"].name,
                "n_extra_vars": len(spec["extra_cols"]),
                "status": "error",
                "error_type": type(exc).__name__,
                "error_message": str(exc),
            }
        )
    gc.collect()

df_summary = pd.DataFrame(summary_rows)
df_summary.to_csv(RESULTS_DIR / "convergence_summary.csv", index=False)
display(df_summary)
```

## 7) Parámetros por modelo

```{python}
#| label: new-variable-parameters-wide-selected
print("label: new-variable-parameters-wide")

# Acepta label corto, por ejemplo:
#   "censo_main_4_plus_osm_main"
# o nombre completo:
#   "mnl_larch_joint_censo_main_4_plus_osm_main"
PARAMETER_MODEL = "mnl_larch_joint_censo_main_4_plus_osm_main"


def resolve_parameter_model(model_or_label: str) -> dict:
    label = model_or_label.removeprefix("mnl_larch_joint_")
    known_specs = dict(JOINT_ROUTE_A_SPECS)
    if label not in known_specs:
        raise ValueError(
            f"Modelo/label desconocido: {model_or_label}. "
            f"Opciones válidas: {sorted(known_specs)}"
        )
    return {
        "model": f"mnl_larch_joint_{label}",
        "label": label,
        "extra_cols": known_specs[label],
        "sample_path": JOINT_SAMPLE_PATH,
    }


def load_parameter_frame(model_or_label: str) -> tuple[dict, pd.DataFrame]:
    spec = resolve_parameter_model(model_or_label)
    params_path, _ = result_paths(spec["model"])
    if not params_path.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(
            f"No existe archivo de parámetros para {spec['model']}: {params_path}"
        )
    return spec, pd.read_csv(params_path)


def parse_larch_parameter_name(name: str) -> tuple[str | None, str | None]:
    suffix = f"_{MODEL_PARTITION}"
    stem = name.removesuffix(suffix)
    if stem == "ASC_QR_RED":
        return "QR_RED", "ASC"
    if stem == "ASC_QR_OTHER":
        return "QR_OTHER", "ASC"
    for alt, prefix in [
        ("QR_OTHER", "B_QR_OTHER_"),
        ("QR_RED", "B_QR_RED_"),
        ("BIP", "B_BIP_"),
    ]:
        if stem.startswith(prefix):
            return alt, stem.removeprefix(prefix)
    return None, None


def parameter_wide_for_variables(
    params_df: pd.DataFrame,
    *,
    model_name: str,
    variable_order: list[str],
    tag_to_variable: dict[str, str],
) -> pl.DataFrame:
    rows = []
    variable_set = set(variable_order)
    for _, row in params_df.iterrows():
        alt, tag = parse_larch_parameter_name(row["Name"])
        variable = tag_to_variable.get(tag)
        if alt is None or variable not in variable_set:
            continue
        rows.append(
            {
                "block": "joint",
                "family": "mnl",
                "model": model_name,
                "variable": variable,
                "alternative": alt,
                "beta": row["Value"],
                "t": row["Robust t-stat."],
                "p_error": row["Robust p-value"],
            }
        )

    long_df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    output_rows = []
    alt_keys = {"BIP": "bip", "QR_OTHER": "qr_other", "QR_RED": "qr_red"}
    for variable in variable_order:
        subset = long_df[long_df["variable"] == variable].set_index("alternative") if not long_df.empty else pd.DataFrame()
        out = {"block": "joint", "family": "mnl", "model": model_name, "variable": variable}
        for alt, key in alt_keys.items():
            out[f"beta_{key}"] = subset.loc[alt, "beta"] if alt in subset.index else None
        for alt, key in alt_keys.items():
            out[f"p_error_{key}"] = subset.loc[alt, "p_error"] if alt in subset.index else None
        for alt, key in alt_keys.items():
            out[f"t_{key}"] = subset.loc[alt, "t"] if alt in subset.index else None
        output_rows.append(out)

    columns = [
        "block", "family", "model", "variable",
        "beta_bip", "beta_qr_other", "beta_qr_red",
        "p_error_bip", "p_error_qr_other", "p_error_qr_red",
        "t_bip", "t_qr_other", "t_qr_red",
    ]
    return pl.from_pandas(pd.DataFrame(output_rows, columns=columns))


def warn_missing_inference(df_wide: pl.DataFrame, *, inference_label: str) -> None:
    pdf = df_wide.to_pandas()
    missing = []
    for key, alt in [("bip", "BIP"), ("qr_other", "QR_OTHER"), ("qr_red", "QR_RED")]:
        has_beta = pdf[f"beta_{key}"].notna()
        missing_inference = pdf[f"t_{key}"].isna() | pdf[f"p_error_{key}"].isna()
        for variable in pdf.loc[has_beta & missing_inference, "variable"].tolist():
            missing.append(f"{variable}:{alt}")
    if missing:
        print(
            f"Advertencia: Larch no entregó inferencia {inference_label} para: "
            + ", ".join(missing)
        )


selected_spec, selected_params = load_parameter_frame(PARAMETER_MODEL)
tag_to_new_variable = {tag: variable for variable, tag in PARAM_TAGS.items()}
df_new_variable_parameters_wide = parameter_wide_for_variables(
    selected_params,
    model_name=selected_spec["model"],
    variable_order=selected_spec["extra_cols"],
    tag_to_variable=tag_to_new_variable,
)
warn_missing_inference(df_new_variable_parameters_wide, inference_label="robusta")
with pl.Config(tbl_rows=-1, tbl_cols=-1, tbl_width_chars=-1):
    display(df_new_variable_parameters_wide)
```

```{python}
        rows.append(

        for alt, key in alt_keys.items():

        for alt, key in alt_keys.items():

        "p_error_bip", "p_error_qr_other", "p_error_qr_red",

    ]
    return pl.from_pandas(pd.DataFrame(output_rows, columns=columns))
```
